hero.title: Accommodation for the trip
hero.description: All booked: Alfar Hotel (1 night), CHECK inn HIVE in Luodong (2 nights) and SOL Hotel (6 nights, 546 EUR).

cards.title: Alfar Hotel (1 night)
cards.description: First night near the airport after the late arrival (10:10pm).

sections.title: Reservation
items: Alfar Hotel - No. 109, Daren Road, 337 Dayuan, Taiwan
Check-in Fri Aug 28 late evening (flight lands at 10:10pm)
Tell the hotel about the late arrival (after 11pm)

cards.title: CHECK inn HIVE (2 nights)
cards.description: Booked. Base for the Luodong night market and the Turtle Island trip.

sections.title: Reservation
items: CHECK inn HIVE - No. 38, Gongzheng Road, Luodong, Yilan 26550
Check-in Sat Aug 29 (after the train from Taipei)
Right across from Luodong station, 5 min from the night market

cards.title: SOL Hotel (6 nights)
cards.description: Booked. Home base for the trip: day trips out, back to Hsinchu every evening.

sections.title: Reservation
items: SOL Hotel - No. 10, Wenhua Street, North District, Hsinchu
Check-in Mon Aug 31 -> Check-out Sun Sep 6
Right in the center: Cheng Huang temple and train station a few minutes on foot
